# REMAINING WORK — Mobile-First Geelooy Social Hub

## Scope boundary
Internal Geelooy Social Hub only. External YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, OAuth, account linking, and external auto-posting remain explicitly excluded by the user.

## Completed creator and core mobile work
- [x] Persistent Create Post action outside route navigation.
- [x] Dominant styled Home creation card and contextual chips.
- [x] Canonical alias/Heichel/Series internal composer URL shared by Home/mobile Create.
- [x] Safe-area/dock clearance, touch size, focus, wrapping, narrow-phone, reduced-motion behavior.
- [x] Creator integration through existing assembly/lifecycle/presenter.
- [x] All creator source/test files <=120 lines.
- [x] All 80 root stylesheet imports normalized to `hub-local-021`.
- [x] Focused creator contract and repaired real surface-ownership contract pass.
- [x] Strengthened 390px real-Chrome creator geometry journey passes.
- [x] `npm run test:all` passed on that creator-complete tree.
- [x] No public test post was created.

## Reopened hidden-work mission
The original requirement also says every element must be styled and no labels/text should be loose. Creation-specific evidence cannot prove all twelve internal routes satisfy that broader standard. The live route model exposes Home, Inbox, Messages, Spaces, People, Profile, Chat, Interact, Activity, Network, References, and Privacy.

## Route-wide quality work
- [x] Read live `RouteModel` and enumerate all twelve routes.
- [x] Read real active-panel contract: `panel.hidden` plus `data-active="true"`.
- [x] Write three-pass route-wide quality plans.
- [ ] Create `BrowserSurfaceQualityInspector.mjs` for objective rendered-surface evidence.
- [ ] Create `BrowserRouteQualityJourney.mjs` to traverse all twelve routes at 390px.
- [ ] Read back and syntax/line-budget check both modules.
- [ ] Run the route-wide browser audit against the deterministic fixture.
- [ ] Record every real route defect with exact evidence.
- [ ] For each real defect, read its template/style owner and fully rewrite the necessary production file(s).
- [ ] Re-read every production repair before rerunning tests.
- [ ] Repeat route-wide audit until objective defects are zero.
- [ ] Integrate the stable route-wide audit into the normal browser smoke covenant.
- [ ] Run `npm run test:all` on the true final tree.
- [ ] Recheck no external-provider leakage and no scoped TODO/FIXME residue.
- [ ] Write/read back route-wide final verification.
- [ ] Empty this ledger only after all twelve routes have browser evidence.

## Objective route-wide gate
For every active route at 390px: positive panel geometry, no document horizontal overflow, no visible descendants escaping viewport unless deliberately contained by horizontal scrolling, no meaningful bare direct text under generic unowned containers, no invisible/zero typography, and no collapsed ordinary mobile controls. The audit may report conservative evidence, but production changes require tracing a real owner and confirming the finding is not an intentional compact/native exception.

## NEXT_ACTION
Create and read back the two small browser quality modules, then run the twelve-route audit without publishing or mutating user data.

The Awtsmoos renews all twelve chambers while each word seeks its proper vessel; Awtsmoos.com will let living Chrome expose what still spills, and only evidence will authorize another garment.
